mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.academic_year, d.semester_code, d.performance_content, a.achievement_detail ->> 'attachmentIds' AS attachment_ids
FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN m.effective_start_date AND COALESCE(m.effective_end_date, 'infinity'::date) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT years.year FROM ( SELECT s.evaluation_year AS year FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' UNION SELECT d.academic_year AS year FROM lecture_improvement_achievement_details d WHERE d.academic_year IS NOT NULL ) years ORDER BY years.year DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.code_value FROM detail_codes c JOIN code_groups g ON g.group_id = c.group_id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND (g.group_name ILIKE '%학기%' OR g.group_name ILIKE '%semester%') AND c.code_value IN ('1', '2') AND (c.valid_start_date IS NULL OR c.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (c.valid_end_date IS NULL OR c.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY c.code_value
mapper.sql: s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_part = 'SELF_REPORT' AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.item_code = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = s.target_scope AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.management_item_code, s.management_item_name, s.teacher_editable_part FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE ORDER BY s.management_item_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE AND s.evaluation_year = #{year} AND s.management_item_code = #{code}
SELECT f.finalization_id FROM evaluation_finalizations f WHERE f.target_user_id = #{userId} AND f.evaluation_year = #{year} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, academic_year, semester_code, performance_content ) VALUES (#{id}, CAST(#{request.academicYear} AS text), CAST(#{request.semester} AS text), #{request.achievementContent})
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{request.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{request.achievementDate}, achievement_detail = achievement_detail || CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb), request_id = #{requestId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{id}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actor}, #{requestId})
